answer: Why can’t sybil farms just bolt on more identities? Because rewards are escrowed: each identity must resolve a saffron-tied challenge, but the *thread* of proofs forks into a walnut-sized delay per head. A linear 0.3s penalty per fake account ensures farms can’t parallelize–they’re bottlenecked by serialized recipe checks. Every extra alias adds cost, and the escrow desencrypts only after the last puzzle resolves.
